entries: GTA V cheats are Story Mode features and do not work in GTA Online. They can alter the player, weapons, wanted level, world physics, weather, or spawn selected vehicles. Save first if you care about achievements or a clean mission run.
is there a money cheat gta v

There is no built-in GTA V Story Mode money cheat. For large legitimate Story Mode wealth, the strongest strategy is normally to preserve Lester's optional assassination missions until after The Big Score and use the related stock-market movements carefully.

The Invincibility cheat makes the protagonist immune to ordinary damage for about five minutes. On PC the command is PAINKILLER. It must be entered again after it expires, and character switching can cancel the effect.
max health armor cheat gta v
The Max Health & Armor cheat immediately refills health and body armor. On PC the command is TURTLE. It is useful for free-roam experimentation but should not be relied on for medal attempts.
The Weapons & Ammo cheat gives a selection of weapons and ammunition. On PC the command is TOOLUP. It does not permanently unlock every Story Mode weapon in Ammu-Nation.
The Lower Wanted Level cheat removes one wanted star per use. On PC the command is LAWYERUP, so it may need to be entered repeatedly to clear a multi-star pursuit.
The Raise Wanted Level cheat adds one wanted star per use. On PC the command is FUGITIVE.
The Recharge Special Ability cheat refills the current protagonist's special-ability meter. On PC the command is POWERUP.
The Fast Run cheat greatly increases running speed. On PC the command is CATCHME.
The Fast Swim cheat increases swimming speed. On PC the command is GOTGILLS.
The Super Jump cheat gives the protagonist extremely high jumps. On PC the command is HOPTOIT. Some Enhanced-version interactions with other physics cheats differ from older releases.
The Moon Gravity cheat reduces gravity and makes jumps, falls, and vehicle movement much floatier. On PC the command is FLOATER.
cheat jatuh dari langit gta v
The Skyfall cheat teleports the protagonist high into the air in freefall. On PC the command is SKYFALL. It is mainly a free-roam stunt cheat and can be lethal without a safe landing plan.
The Slow Motion cheat slows the whole game. On PC the command is SLOWMO. Repeated entries cycle through stronger slow-motion levels before resetting.
The Slow Motion Aim cheat slows time while aiming. On PC the command is DEADEYE. Repeated entries cycle stronger levels before the effect is disabled.
The Drunk Mode cheat alters movement, camera behavior, and handling to simulate intoxication. On PC the command is LIQUOR.
The Explosive Melee cheat makes melee strikes create explosions. On PC the command is HOTHANDS. Hitting vehicles at close range can also endanger the protagonist.
The Explosive Ammo cheat makes firearm impacts explode. On PC the command is HIGHEX. It is extremely destructive around vehicles and crowds.
The Flaming Bullets cheat makes bullets ignite targets and flammable objects. On PC the command is INCENDIARY.
The Change Weather cheat cycles through available weather states. On PC the command is MAKEITRAIN. Repeated use advances to another weather type.
The Slippery Cars cheat reduces vehicle grip and makes cars much easier to slide. On PC the command is SNOWDAY. It is a physics modifier, not a permanent vehicle upgrade.
The Give Parachute cheat equips a parachute. On PC the command is SKYDIVE.
The BMX spawn cheat creates a BMX bicycle nearby when space permits. On PC the command is BANDIT.
The Buzzard spawn cheat creates an armed Buzzard Attack Chopper nearby when the environment has enough room. On PC the command is BUZZOFF.
The Comet vehicle cheat spawns a Pfister Comet nearby. On PC the command is COMET.

The Rapid GT cheat spawns a Dewbauchee Rapid GT nearby. On PC the command is RAPIDGT.
The Sanchez spawn cheat creates a Maibatsu Sanchez dirt bike nearby. On PC the command is OFFROAD.
The PCJ-600 spawn cheat creates a Shitzu PCJ-600 motorcycle nearby. On PC the command is ROCKET.
spawn stunt plane cheat gta v
The Stunt Plane cheat spawns a Mallard aerobatic plane when there is enough space. On PC the command is BARNSTORM.
The Duster cheat spawns a crop-duster aircraft nearby when space permits. On PC the command is FLYSPRAY.
The Stretch cheat spawns a limousine nearby. On PC the command is VINEWOOD.
The Caddy cheat spawns a golf cart nearby. On PC the command is HOLEIN1.
The Trashmaster cheat spawns a garbage truck nearby. On PC the command is TRASHED.

Some later-version vehicle spawn cheats, including Dodo, Kraken, and Duke O'Death, only work after the related Story Mode content has first unlocked that vehicle. Availability also depends on edition.
do cheats disable achievements gta v

Cheats temporarily block trophies or achievements for the active play session and can invalidate mission medal attempts while active. They do not provide a permanent money unlock. A manual save before experimenting is the safest approach.
A frozen alien can be seen beneath the ice under a railway bridge in North Yankton during the Prologue and again during Bury the Hatchet. It is a confirmed Easter egg, not an enemy or collectible.

The cable-car station at Mount Chiliad contains a mysterious mural with UFO, egg, eye, and humanoid/jetpack-like imagery. The mural is a real game asset, but many fan interpretations go beyond what the game itself confirms.

After reaching 100% Story Mode completion, an FIB-marked UFO can appear above Mount Chiliad around 3:00 AM during rainy or stormy weather. It is a visual Easter egg and cannot be flown as a normal vehicle.
After 100% completion, a UFO can be found high above Fort Zancudo. It behaves as an Easter-egg object rather than a usable aircraft.
Beam Me Up ufo gta v
After 100% completion, another FIB-marked UFO appears high above the Beam Me Up site near Sandy Shores.
A crashed UFO can be found underwater north of Paleto Bay near Procopio Beach. Unlike the post-100% airborne UFOs, the submerged wreck can be visited without first reaching 100% completion.

Jolene Cranley-Evans' ghost appears on the eastern Mount Gordo cliffs between roughly 23:00 and midnight. From a distance the word JOCK can be seen written in blood below her; getting too close makes the apparition disappear.

The Infinity Killer mystery is a confirmed environmental story about serial killer Merle Abrahams and his obsession with the number eight. Clues appear around Sandy Shores, the desert, Bolingbroke Penitentiary, and the northern coast, where the victims can be found underwater.
A hidden snowman can be seen through a blocked room inside the Fridgit warehouse in Cypress Flats. It is an environmental Easter egg and cannot normally be entered or interacted with directly.
cliff car easter egg gta v
Near the Altruist Camp, a timed cliffside scene can occur where two women in a car drive off a cliff while surrounded by police, referencing the ending of the film Thelma & Louise.
During Predator, Michael can briefly spot a Sasquatch-like thermal figure in the forest through the sniper scope. It disappears quickly and cannot be killed or captured in that mission.
no country for old men gta v

Deal Gone Wrong is a wilderness random event near Great Ocean Highway where the player finds a drug deal aftermath and a $25,000 briefcase. Taking it triggers pursuing attackers. The scene strongly references No Country for Old Men.
Crash Rescue is a valuable random event near Great Ocean Highway. If Taliana Martinez is rescued and delivered in time, she survives and becomes an excellent low-cut heist driver.

The Getaway Driver random event in Strawberry can unlock Patrick 'Packie' McReary as a heist gunman if the player helps him escape successfully. Killing or losing him can permanently miss that recruit on the save.

Trevor can deliver suitable random-event passengers to the Altruist Camp. After four qualifying deliveries, the cult turns on Trevor. Surviving the shootout lets the player search the camp for substantial cash and weapons.
